exact_result: Retained source-scope corrections and rigorous elementary tree, fixed-cycle rounding, convex-cap and monotone-shift diagnostics. The requested completed-algebraic-closure two-sign first-stage ordinary CLD-smooth decreasing psh approximation theorem for all actual pure analytic curves is not established.
concrete_gaps: The needed completed-algebraic-closure ordinary-current transport has not been independently reconstructed here with exact compact form descent, wild/Frobenius stages, componentwise purity and actual top-measure lengths.

The full reduction, normalization, conductor, continuous rigid-puncture and component-current bridge has not been established here for singular or nonreduced curves with unequal generic Artinian lengths.

The actual fixed compact strict affinoid and its semistable formal-open/local finite-tree realization, inside each prescribed ordinary neighborhood and with the actual Shilov boundary, have not been proved in this attempt.
Simultaneous residual principal unit-log lifts, every-direction slopes, whole annular collars and exact ordinary-open overlap gluing are not proved here.

Consequently no two-sign pair of ordinary CLD-smooth decreasing psh sequences on one common fixed compact affinoid has been constructed in the full requested scope. General transcendental ascent, downstairs all-K approximation and the full original P06.2 atom remain unresolved.
